_comment: Tracks directory seed for /information/tracks. Built 2026-07-07 from our OWN content/circuits.json (coordinates are VERIFIED against that curated file; the loader flags coordsVerified=true on match). Country/type/summary were hand-added at high confidence for these well-known venues but are NOT yet editor-fact-checked (length/turns/opened intentionally omitted rather than guessed), so every entry ships review:'unverified' → noindex, excluded from search, shown under a draft banner. WORKAROUND NOTE: the broader ~150-venue worldwide dataset (all countries/disciplines, with lengths + opening years) was researched by an agent that stalled mid-stream twice; regenerating it is a follow-up. To publish a track: verify its facts, add "review":"verified" (+ "featured":true to index it).

tracks.name: Silverstone Circuit
tracks.summary: Home of the British Grand Prix and the venue of the very first Formula 1 World Championship race in 1950.

tracks.name: Circuit de Monaco
tracks.summary: The iconic Monte Carlo street circuit, the most glamorous and demanding race on the Formula 1 calendar.

tracks.name: Autodromo Nazionale Monza
tracks.summary: The 'Temple of Speed' near Milan, the fastest circuit in Formula 1 and the spiritual home of the Italian Grand Prix.

tracks.name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
tracks.summary: A long, fast circuit in the Ardennes forest famous for the Eau Rouge–Raidillon complex and changeable weather.

tracks.name: Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari
tracks.summary: A classic old-school circuit named after Ferrari's founder and his son, host of the Emilia-Romagna Grand Prix.

tracks.name: Circuit Zandvoort
tracks.summary: A sweeping, dune-lined circuit on the Dutch coast, known for its steeply banked corners.

tracks.name: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
tracks.summary: A technical circuit near Barcelona long used for both racing and pre-season testing.

tracks.name: Red Bull Ring
tracks.summary: A short, fast circuit set in the Styrian mountains, host of the Austrian Grand Prix.

tracks.name: Hungaroring
tracks.summary: A tight, twisty circuit near Budapest often likened to a go-kart track for its lack of straights.

tracks.name: Nürburgring
tracks.summary: Home of the legendary Nordschleife, the fearsome 'Green Hell', and a modern Grand Prix circuit.

tracks.name: Circuit de la Sarthe
tracks.summary: The part-public-road circuit that hosts the 24 Hours of Le Mans, endurance racing's greatest event.

tracks.name: Sebring International Raceway
tracks.summary: A bumpy former airfield circuit in Florida, home of the historic 12 Hours of Sebring.

tracks.name: Fuji Speedway
tracks.summary: A fast circuit in the shadow of Mount Fuji with one of the longest straights in the world.

tracks.name: Suzuka International Racing Course
tracks.summary: A unique figure-of-eight layout beloved by drivers, host of the Japanese Grand Prix.

tracks.name: Albert Park Circuit
tracks.summary: A parkland street circuit around a Melbourne lake, traditional opener of the Formula 1 season.

tracks.name: Autódromo José Carlos Pace
tracks.summary: A short, undulating anti-clockwise circuit in São Paulo famous for dramatic, wet Grands Prix.

tracks.name: Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
tracks.summary: A high-altitude circuit in Mexico City whose thin air challenges cars, ending with a stadium section.

tracks.name: Circuit of the Americas
tracks.summary: A purpose-built circuit in Austin, Texas, hosting the United States Grand Prix and MotoGP.

tracks.name: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve
tracks.summary: A semi-permanent circuit on an island in Montreal, known for its 'Wall of Champions'.

tracks.name: Baku City Circuit
tracks.summary: A street circuit in Azerbaijan's capital combining a long blast along the seafront with a tight castle section.

tracks.name: Marina Bay Street Circuit
tracks.summary: A demanding, humid night race on the streets of Singapore.

tracks.name: Jeddah Corniche Circuit
tracks.summary: An exceptionally fast street circuit along the Red Sea coast in Jeddah.

tracks.name: Bahrain International Circuit
tracks.summary: A desert circuit in Sakhir, often the season opener and a regular night race.

tracks.name: Lusail International Circuit
tracks.summary: A floodlit circuit near Doha hosting both the Qatar Grand Prix and MotoGP.

tracks.name: Yas Marina Circuit
tracks.summary: A marina-side circuit in Abu Dhabi, traditional season finale with a day-to-night race.

tracks.name: Shanghai International Circuit
tracks.summary: A modern circuit host of the Chinese Grand Prix, famous for its long, tightening first corner.

tracks.name: Miami International Autodrome
tracks.summary: A temporary circuit around the Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens, Florida.

tracks.name: Las Vegas Strip Circuit
tracks.summary: A high-speed night race down the Las Vegas Strip.

tracks.name: Algarve International Circuit
tracks.summary: A rollercoaster circuit in Portugal's Algarve with dramatic elevation changes.

tracks.name: Mugello Circuit
tracks.summary: A flowing, fast circuit in the Tuscan hills, a favourite venue for MotoGP.

tracks.name: Sachsenring
tracks.summary: A short, twisty circuit in Saxony dominated by left-hand corners, a MotoGP mainstay.

tracks.name: Termas de Río Hondo
tracks.summary: A modern circuit in northern Argentina that has hosted the Argentine motorcycle Grand Prix.

tracks.name: Autodrom Most
tracks.summary: A circuit in the northwest of the Czech Republic used by World Superbikes and other series.

tracks.name: Indianapolis Motor Speedway
tracks.summary: The 2.5-mile 'Brickyard' oval, home of the Indianapolis 500, one of motorsport's Triple Crown events.

tracks.name: Daytona International Speedway
tracks.summary: A high-banked Florida superspeedway hosting the Daytona 500 and the Rolex 24 endurance race.

tracks.name: Talladega Superspeedway
tracks.summary: NASCAR's largest and fastest oval, in Alabama, known for huge drafting packs.

tracks.name: Charlotte Motor Speedway
tracks.summary: A North Carolina speedway hosting NASCAR's Coca-Cola 600, the sport's longest race.

tracks.name: Dover Motor Speedway
tracks.summary: A high-banked concrete oval in Delaware nicknamed the 'Monster Mile'.
